test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 4 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following sectors in Indian economy is also known as service sector?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Tertiary sector.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Tertiary sector** is also known as the **service sector** in the Indian economy.
 
• This sector includes industries that provide **services** rather than goods, such as banking, education, healthcare, and IT services.
 
• The tertiary sector has become the **largest contributor** to India’s GDP, contributing more than 50% to the economy.
 
• This sector plays a crucial role in providing employment opportunities, especially in urban areas, and supports other sectors like manufacturing and agriculture.
 
• In India, the rapid growth of the tertiary sector has been driven by advancements in **technology, infrastructure, and globalization**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Primary Sector**:

 
 
• The primary sector involves the extraction of raw materials from nature, such as agriculture, mining, and fishing.
 
 
 
• **Secondary Sector**:
 
 
• The secondary sector is involved in the manufacturing and processing of raw materials into finished goods, including industries like construction, manufacturing, and textiles.
 
 
 
• **Unorganised Sector**:
 
 
• This sector includes small-scale businesses that operate without formal registration or government regulation, providing employment without consistent benefits.
 
 
 
• **Growth of Tertiary Sector in India**:
 
 
• The development of **information technology (IT)** and the rise of the **BPO industry** have been key drivers of growth in the service sector in India.
 
• The Indian government has also been promoting **foreign investment** in the service sector, enhancing infrastructure and financial services.
